measurements, flags with the value and threshold behind each, and the settings in force.

delete.description: Remove the timeline. Files already exported stay in the exports folder.

One row per clip: transcript state, language, and how much text there is.

Keyword search in the project's transcripts (all words must occur; each matches the start

get.description:
Faces not with any person: marked "not a face" (ignored) or "unknown person" by the user,
or seen too briefly to group (brief).

post.description: Move faces to another person, set them aside, or hand them back to automatic grouping.

Faces found in one clip: counts, what the checks left out, and the tracks with the
person each one was grouped with.
People whose faces look most alike, closest first: questions for the user.

post.description: Same person: merge the two. Different people: keep them apart in every later grouping.

put.description:
Before a shot: start a scene (`split`), keep it with the shot before (`join`), or let
the similarity decide again (`auto`).

Tags shown somewhere in the project (approved, or above the threshold and not

ActorPairOut.title: ActorPairOut
ActorPairOut.description: Two people the grouping kept apart although their faces look alike.

SpeechLanguages.title: SpeechLanguages
SpeechLanguages.description:
What the user said about a project's speech (kept in the project's settings). Detection
picks among `languages` (empty = any language Whisper knows). Languages in `detect_only`
are recognised but not written down: for them the model's text was judged too poor to be
useful, so the clip shows that it has speech in that language and no transcript.
